ai.title: Anthropic says it’s committing 5% of its shares to a ‘public benefit fund’
ai.brief: Anthropic announced today that it’s creating a “public benefit fund” that will give the company “increased flexibility and scale” to support projects for societal good. Anthropic said that it will commit 5% of its shares to the fund — structured as a wholly-owned entity within the company — with the option to contribute an additional 2% for every 50% increase in Anthropic’s value. ” There’s also the impact that AI might have on the job market, which Anthropic has already committed $200 million to study . But the company said, “Given the pace of AI progress, bolder approaches may be needed. ”

sec.title: 16-Year-Old Broadcom Wi-Fi Bug Lets Attackers Take Over Routers Without a Password
sec.brief: S. S. S. S. 11 implementation that has been present in their SDK since at least 2010. The bug allows an attacker to get unauthenticated remote code execution on affected routers without knowing the WiFi password or going through the normal WPS setup process. As of October 15, 2026, none of the affected devices in Belgium had received a patch.
